tree: Twinlink builds AI that does the work for you. Founded in Paris, the company trains action models and deploys agents that operate real software: browsing, clicking, typing, and completing tasks across web, desktop, and enterprise systems. Its products are Twinlink Platform, the developer platform with the Agents API, Models API, CLI, and SDKs, and HoloTab, the browser companion.
